apps.name: deepfake
apps.subtitle: Your music from YouTube Music, no ads
apps.localizedDescription: deepfake for iPhone: playlists, Liked Songs, Smart Shuffle, My Wave, lyrics, stats and Wi-Fi sync with deepfake on your computer.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Riff syncs your library with Riff on your computer over Wi-Fi.

apps.versionDescription:
Top moments, and a different upload
• Top moments, in the player's ••• menu: mark the part of a song you like; it shows as a heart on the time bar and you can jump straight to it
• Play a different upload, in a song's menu: when the wrong video plays, pick another upload of it; it stays picked everywhere the song is saved

Built from 5f6a484.

Control Center back from Instagram
• Your Instagram from FlareStore shares deepfake's certificate, so to iOS it's the same app: its videos could take Control Center and the lock screen as "deepfake" with no song, and play went to Instagram
• When Instagram stops playing sound, and whenever you open deepfake, deepfake now takes Control Center back with your song, even while paused
• This is a test: Settings, About, Playback log shows whether iOS allowed it

Built from 8fb5dce.

A seek bar that goes where you put it
• Touch anywhere on the song bar to jump there, then drag; you no longer have to catch the thin knob
• A drag that drifts up or down keeps seeking instead of scrolling the player
• The bar stays where you let go instead of jumping back for a moment

Built from 9883fd0.

deepfake account
• Settings, Integrations, deepfake account: sign in, and your liked songs stay the same as on your computer from anywhere, not only on the same Wi-Fi
• A like or unlike shows up on the other device within seconds while both are open, or the next time the app opens
• Sign in on the computer first (Settings, Storage, deepfake account), and sync over Wi-Fi once before signing in here
• Wi-Fi sync keeps doing everything else: playlists, stats, settings, files from your computer and the remote

Built from 8712124.

Motion is back
• The player, queue and lyrics slide up again, and screens fade in as they open
• The queue scrolls up and down only; it no longer slides sideways under your thumb
• The part of a song that has played shows bright on the progress bar
• Tapping a search bar lights the whole bar

Built from f6c3ac0.

Tapping the lock screen player opens deepfake
• deepfake now has the app id FlareStore's certificate is made for, so the lock screen and Control Center player open it when tapped
• It installs as a new app: sync with your computer first, pair again in the new one, then delete the old one

Built from c265956.
